Knowledge & code tools
Search project knowledge, explore code relationships, or plan multi-step work.
Save a knowledge document Pinned documents are included in Harness context.
Explore code relationships and path queries 
Choose Scan workspace or Run query to inspect symbols, callers, paths, and complexity.
Context compaction and searchable tool results

Large tool results can be stored and searched instead of filling the active context. Use ctx_search to retrieve relevant sections or ctx_execute_python to analyze files. Use Compact in Harness to summarize a long session.

Plan, implement, and verify in separate waves

The workflow separates planning, implementation, and verification into three waves. It records progress in planning files, unloads local models between lead and verifier stages, and blocks reads of common secret files.

Optional local MCP tools

Optional command-line MCP servers can be added from the MCP tools panel. Presets are available for Context Mode, CodeGraph, and related local tools.

MCP hub
Loading catalog…
Every card states its transport, trust level, key requirement and approval policy before you connect it.
Add or edit a serverPick a catalog card to prefill, or enter your own.
Step 1 of 4 · Server

Name the server

A catalog card fills this in. The harness calls each tool mcp__alias__tool, so the alias has to be short, unique and stable.

Say how it is reached

The token is sent once, stored by the server's credential store, and only ever shown back as a mask. It is never written to this page's DOM, a log or the review below.

Advanced: raw headers and environment JSON

Only for servers the guide cannot describe. Values with a sensitive name are stored in the credential store and shown back masked.

Choose what a tool call costs you

A local command only starts when the server itself has been started with STUDIO_ALLOW_MCP_STDIO=1. This screen records your consent; it cannot grant that permission, and it does not weaken the sandbox.

Review, then connect and test

Connecting saves the server and asks it for its tools in one step: that request is the connection test, and its result appears below.
